source_metadata.title: Infectious Diseases Society of America 2026 Guidance on the Treatment of Antimicrobial-Resistant Gram-Negative Infections
source_metadata.content_scope: Section 4, Pseudomonas aeruginosa with Difficult-to-Treat Resistance (DTR P. aeruginosa), beginning on page 42; preceding CRE text on page 42 excluded.

extraction_limitations: The governing LiteratureAtom model is designed for primary literature, whereas ciag481 is an expert guidance document. Guideline recommendations were mapped to author_conclusion and descriptive/mechanistic guidance content to other or qualitative_result because the schema has no dedicated guideline_recommendation atom kind.

Quantitative findings in this page range are secondary reports of cited studies or surveillance datasets, not results generated by the guidance document itself. Tags identify the extraction as guideline-derived; users should extract cited primary studies separately when primary-study provenance is required.
Only PDF pages 42-51 were parsed. The CRE rationale preceding the Section 4 heading on page 42 was deliberately excluded.
Page 51 ends mid-rationale for Question 4.7. Assertions requiring text from page 52 were not extracted; only complete or independently interpretable statements visible on page 51 were included.
No external verification was performed. Extraction is grounded in the uploaded PDF and project @ATOM sources.
All atoms remain needs_review because this is language-model extraction and no human verification step was performed.
